tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Navigates to Attention's demo-scheduling page (powered by Default). The page opens a calendar where the user picks a time with the sales team. Optionally pre-fills a note with context (company, team size, use-case).

note.description: Optional context (company name, use-case, team size) to pre-fill on the booking form.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the Attention product docs and API reference by filtering the published llms.txt index at docs.attention.com/llms.txt. Returns an array of {title, url, snippet} matches. Use this before recommending doc pages to the user so citations resolve to real URLs.
